Travel southwest to drive off a group of [[Grawl Invader]]s, by using two new [[sword skills]] that [[Warmaster Grast]] taught you.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = y
| profession = warrior
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Look for Grawl invaders along the road. Eliminate them.
* Return to Warmaster Grast for your reward.

===Early benefits===
*Warmaster Grast will give you a [[Starter Sword]] and the following skills upon taking the quest:
**{{skill icon|Sever Artery}}
**{{skill icon|Gash}}
**{{skill icon|Healing Signet}}

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
Follow the southwest road until you come across the Grawl Invaders. Kill them and head back to Grast for your reward.

==NPCs==
===Foes===
[[Grawl]]
*{{r}} 1 [[Grawl Invader]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Warmaster Grast
:''"I should warn you that there's trouble on the road. A group of Grawl Invaders have camped out not far from here, and have been harassing travelers. If you'd like, I can teach you a thing or two to help drive them off. I'll even lend you a sword if you need one."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = These creatures must be taught a lesson!
| decline = I don't think I'm ready to take them on.
| ask = Not afraid of a few Grawl are you? Just head up the road and use the sword skills I showed you. Eliminate the Grawl invaders and report back to me.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Warmaster Grast
:''"Ah, that's a relief. The only good grawl's a dead Grawl, I say."''

==Trivia==
* Unlike the other quests required to get a secondary profession in Pre-Searing ([[A Monk's Mission]], [[The Ranger's Companion]], [[A Mesmer's Burden]],  [[The Elementalist Experiment]] and [[The Necromancer's Novice]]), this quest does not have the profession mentioned in its name. Considering that there is another quest called [[Warrior's Challenge]], it may have been that both quest were supposed to be swapped initially.

{{Anomaly|Grawl Invaders will continue to be present on subsequent visits to the area even after the completion of the quest.}}
